assessment: The source explicitly gives the Jackson-Hunt characteristic spacing lambda_JH = sqrt[d0 D/(Vs P)] for the initial directional solidification, reports Vs from 1 to 10 um s^-1, tabulates d0=0.011 um and D=500 um^2 s^-1, and reports P approximately 0.0293. The ScienceCard preserves that theoretical characteristic spacing rather than claiming the realized lamellar spacing is identical to it; its formula, printed central parameters, units, control/readout definitions, Cartesian interval, applicability, and anchors are all supported. Deterministic evaluation of the reported characteristic relation with the printed central P is appropriate.

issues.detail: The source says the resulting lamellar spacing is close to lambda_JH. This is non-blocking because the card readout is explicitly lambda_JH, not the observed spacing.
P is reported approximately as 0.0293; the card uses that printed central value as the deterministic parameter without adding precision.

controls.definition: Imposed directional-solidification velocity used to form the lamellar structure before melting.
controls.name: Vs

applicability.statement: The relation describes the initial directional solidification of the CBr4-C2Cl6 lamellar structure in both experiments and simulations.
The resulting spacing is stated to be close to, rather than exactly equal to, the Jackson-Hunt spacing.

readouts.definition: Jackson-Hunt characteristic spacing to which the resulting lamellar spacing is reported to be close.
readouts.name: lambda_JH
